headerDisplay: Read-only Northbound/OpenAPI monitoring for home automations. A normal FusionSolar app password is insufficient. Power readings are intended for Controller for HomeKit; Apple Home shows selected standard sensors. Detailed diagnostics are optional. The plugin does not control the inverter.

baseUrl.title: FusionSolar server (HTTPS)
baseUrl.description: Your account server, for example https://eu5.fusionsolar.huawei.com. Verify your region; the example is not automatic region selection.

username.title: Northbound/OpenAPI username
username.description: May be omitted when FUSIONSOLAR_USERNAME is set in the Homebridge service environment.

password.title: Northbound/OpenAPI password
password.description: May be omitted when FUSIONSOLAR_PASSWORD is set. Homebridge stores values entered here in its configuration.

stationCodes.title: Selected plant identifiers
stationCodes.description: Optional. An empty list selects all assigned plants (up to 100). Use API plantCode, for example NE=12345678.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Delay after each cycle finishes. Huawei usually refreshes data every five minutes. Integrations on the same account share API quotas.

alarms.title: Read active alarms
alarms.description: Polled every 30 minutes. Cleared alarm history is not returned.

statusSensors.title: Virtual sensors in Apple Home
statusSensors.description: Contact sensors indicate a plant fault or positive PV production. They are virtual indicators, not physical contacts.

writeSnapshot.title: Local full-reading snapshot
writeSnapshot.description: Writes full validated returned records for polled sources and full alarm descriptions under huawei-fusionsolar-monitor in Homebridge storage. Diagnostic device KPIs are only polled with Detailed diagnostic telemetry. Owner-only permissions; excludes passwords and tokens.

demo.title: Demo mode (synthetic data)
demo.description: Shows synthetic data without Huawei connections or an API account. Real credentials are required after disabling demo.

powerMeters.title: Power measurement services
powerMeters.description: Adds PV Production and estimated Home Consumption inside existing accessories. Meters show signed Grid Power, plus Grid Import/Export when direction is configured. Configured Grid Power is positive for import and negative for export. Disable to remove these power services; detailed raw metrics require Detailed diagnostic telemetry.

gridPowerDirection.title: Grid meter power direction
gridPowerDirection.description: Direction of the RAW API reading. If negative means import and positive means export, choose positiveExport. Grid Power is then displayed as positive import / negative export. Applies to selected grid-connection meters across all selected plants.

gridMeterId.title: Grid meter device ID (optional)
gridMeterId.description: Exact decimal device ID as a string. Omit for automatic selection of the unique plant meter. Use to resolve multiple meters; no whitespace or numeric values.

advancedTelemetry.title: Detailed diagnostic telemetry
advancedTelemetry.description: Optional; not needed for normal automations. Exposes all raw KPI groups, inverter temperature and alarm details. Also reads diagnostic device KPIs.

matterEnergy.title: Native Matter home energy
matterEnergy.description: Publishes one read-only whole-home power sensor per plant through Homebridge Matter. Requires Homebridge 2.5+, Matter enabled on this plugin's bridge, separate Matter pairing in Apple Home, and a confirmed grid meter direction. Keeps existing HomeKit accessories. Actual Energy-category display depends on the Apple OS/controller.
